blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Customs (BOC) on Thursday announced that it seized P291.61 million worth of suspected shabu at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia). Customs authorities at the airport intercepted and recovered a total of 42.884 kilograms of the illegal drugs, which came in three separate shipments from Kenya and Malaysia, earlier this month. READ: https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2347085/boc-naia-seizes-p369-44m-worth-of-kush-from-thailand The largest haul, which was initially declared as spare parts, came from Kenya. But after further inspection, authorities found some 39.418 kilograms of illegal substance concealed in the shipment.
